# Integral native ISA v0.21 data

`integral_native_isa_v21.json` is the compact machine ledger for the deterministic height-one pair, its word-rank filtration, exact characteristic-zero separator-unit invariants, degree-eight coupling dimensions, task-section optima and cost comparison with the historical dense pair.

`integral_native_isa_v21.npz` freezes the two ternary generators, all native and Hecke synchronized word evaluations through degree nine modulo `p=1000003`, the degree-eight aligned coupling-signature maps, and the two relation spaces.

`word_names_v21.json` gives the binary word order used by the arrays.

`separator_quartic_inverse_v21.json` freezes a complete two-sided rational inverse of `q(G)=G^4-26G^3-131G^2+300G+900I`. All inverse coordinates are represented by one common denominator plus 486 integer numerators in the native packing order documented in the file.

The modular rank certificates imply the stated characteristic-zero ranks because every relevant matrix is the reduction of an integral matrix. The degree-eight signature coordinates themselves are not claimed to be a canonical integral lattice realization.
